tagline: The world's most popular language learning platform
hero_kpi_rationale: Monthly Active Users (MAUs) is a key indicator of Duolingo's platform growth and engagement, reflecting its dominant position in the language learning market.

kpis.name: Monthly Active Users
kpis.explanation: Number of unique users who use the Duolingo app or the learning section of the website each month.
kpis.description: Key indicator of platform growth and engagement. Tracked annually by company analysts, with historical data available for the past 5 years.
kpis.signal: 14% growth compared to the prior year.

kpis.name: Daily Active Users
kpis.explanation: Number of unique users who use the Duolingo app or the learning section of the website each day.
kpis.signal: 30% growth compared to the prior year.

kpis.name: Paid Subscribers
kpis.explanation: Number of users paying for premium features (Super Duolingo or Duolingo Max) at the end of the reporting period.
kpis.description: Key indicator of revenue generation and conversion of free users.
kpis.signal: 28% growth compared to the prior year.

kpis.name: Subscription Bookings
kpis.explanation: Total subscription booking revenue for the calendar year.
kpis.description: Key indicator of subscription revenue generation.
kpis.signal: 36% growth compared to the prior year.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Company's net income for the calendar year, including tax benefits.
kpis.signal: 367% growth compared to the prior year, driven by a tax provision benefit of $256.7M.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a rapidly evolving market, with new entrants and technological innovations that could threaten its leading position.

risks.title: Data Dependency
risks.score_rationale: The company relies heavily on user-generated data to improve its product and make business decisions.

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: Data privacy and protection regulations could impact the company's operations.

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: Cyberattacks could compromise user data and damage the company's reputation.

risks.title: Platform Dependency
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly dependent on mobile application platforms to distribute its product.

risks.title: Employee-Related Risks
risks.score_rationale: The loss of key personnel or difficulty attracting and retaining talent could impact the company's ability to innovate and grow.

ai_positioning.summary: Duolingo integrates artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning as core components of its educational platform, leveraging massive user engagement data to power sophisticated AI techniques and continuously improve learning engagement and effectiveness.
evidence: Products are powered by sophisticated data analytics and AI
Machine learning is used to improve learning outcomes
Users generate 2 billion exercises per day, fueling high-volume A/B testing and novel AI techniques
